description: Add paper trading mode with virtual P&L tracking - PaperTrader class with SQLite persistence, position management (buy/sell/TP/SL/trailing stop), integration into main loop with 5-min price checks, hourly portfolio updates, and daily summaries.
steps: Create memescanner/paper_trader.py with PaperTrader class implementing all position management logic
Update memescanner/__main__.py to integrate paper trader into the main loop with proper timing
acceptance_criteria: PaperTrader class has __init__(starting_balance=1000, trade_size=50), balance, positions, closed_trades
buy() opens a position if balance allows, max 20 open positions
check_positions() updates prices via DEXScreener, triggers TP at +100%, SL at -50%, trailing stop
At +100% sell half, move stop to breakeven; if price drops to entry after TP sell remainder
get_daily_summary() returns daily P&L summary string
SQLite paper_positions table persists all positions across restarts
Main loop integrates: buy on signal, check positions every 5min, hourly portfolio update, daily summary at midnight ET
Telegram messages match exact formats specified in requirements
